experiment: ROM-sensitive 12A DAC hypothesis on buffered serial line

fixture.latch: every 375th candidate 12A->127 NAND edge, early gate order
fixture.analog: A2 mid-code mute and assumed bandpass; gain to peak 110
fixture.receiver: real-PROM mask04 plus frozen 46/93 and margin external readouts

limitations: The PROM gate, divider, latch data/clock pins, DAC bus, analog filter and ADC path are assumptions.
The frozen receive decision logic and paced USART/8031 interface are external models; no onboard RxD route is traced.
The buffered bit-pair decoder and controller-to-DSC route remain conditional.
